title: Bears RB Kyle Monangai day-to-day with soft tissue injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears RB Kyle Monangai day-to-day with soft tissue injury
sources.description: Bears running back Kyle Monangai has been out of practice since the first day of training camp and head coach Ben Johnson gave an update on his condition at a Monday press conference.
